observed: When multiple qualifying GUT contamination-triage receipts canonicalize to one provenance signature, dynamic decomposition v0.3 selected qualified[0] as the raw provenance/receipt representative. Reversing equivalent alias receipt arrival order could therefore alter emitted provenance metadata even though decomposition behavior should be structurally identical.
risk: Order-dependent provenance metadata can create false procedural significance, unstable replay/audit output, and downstream divergence despite equivalent canonical evidence.
patch: dynamic-decomposition v0.4 removes first-arrival representative metadata from generated facets, retains a deterministic aliasAudit containing all qualifying receipt fingerprints/provenance surfaces, and verifies order-independent facets plus provenance audit.
provenance: Synthetic de-identified receipt fixtures only. No private Drive names, IDs, URLs, or source text are stored.
boundary: The patch stabilizes structural provenance audit ordering; it does not prove source truth, semantic alias equivalence, contamination-classification quality, or connector execution.
